name: Rebecca Rosso
source:
A news reporter for a news channel called Canale Zero, which is broadcast throughout Europe.

Along with her cameraman, Luca, she travels across Europe, focusing on investigating and reporting stories.

She doubts the police statements surrounding the incident the main characters are involved in. To uncover the truth, she decides to get closer to the main characters and hear their stories in the name of investigation.

Hometown: Italy
